description: October 23 birthday meaning: Libra or Scorpio cusp, birthday number 5, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, October 23 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Libra or Scorpio. In numerology the day gives birthday number 5, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: October 23 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: The 23rd of October straddles two very different signs. Depending on year and time of birth, the Sun is in the final degree of Libra or the opening of Scorpio. Libra brings charm and balance; Scorpio, ruled by Pluto, brings depth and privacy. Twenty-three reduces to 5, adding curiosity, so the blend reads as sociable on the surface and investigative underneath.

On October 23 the Sun usually sits at about 29° Libra, in the third decan, where Mercury is the sub-ruler alongside Venus. The cusp between Libra and Scorpio, around October 22 to October 24, places charm next to intensity. The Sun leaves a cardinal air sign for a fixed water sign at a moment that drifts from year to year, so which one you are depends on the year, hour and place of your birth. A properly calculated chart gives the answer. Traditionally, people near this line blend Libra's social grace with Scorpio's depth and focus. They are often described as magnetic and perceptive, pleasant on the surface and quietly determined underneath, with more going on than they show.

sections.heading: October 23 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 23rd, you have a compound of 2 + 3 = 5. The 2 brings sensitivity and the 3 brings expression, and the 5 that results is curious, social and quick on its feet. People born on the 23rd are often described as excellent communicators with a gift for reading people and a strong appetite for new experiences. Travel, languages and varied work tend to appeal. Among the day numbers, the 23 is traditionally seen as one of the most adaptable. Commitment can feel restrictive, so choosing carefully what to say yes to helps them keep their freedom meaningful.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one October 23 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on October 23: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 23 is the 296th day of the year (297th in a leap year). By October 24, 1 day later, the Sun has usually moved on into Scorpio.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by October 23, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on October 23 include Pelé (1940), Paul Kagame (1957) and "Weird Al" Yankovic (1959).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 23?
faq.answer: October 23 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Libra or Scorpio on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Libra. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 23?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 23 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 5 for everyone born on the 23rd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 23?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 23 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 23?
faq.answer: October 23 is also the birthday of Pelé (1940), Paul Kagame (1957) and "Weird Al" Yankovic (1959). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
